notes.title: 🌟 Extra DLC Release! 🍭
notes.content:
Hey, little critters!

The Extra DLC pack is finally here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3582580/Artificial_Fashionista__Extra_Collection/

This pack is the biggest one so far, containing [b]9 outfits[/b] with [b]over 70 individual items[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/7654b3a11468d6608bb20e66947902af877eeb2d.png[/img]

Huge thanks to [b]Boonie[/b] for designing the [i]Retrofuture[/i] outfit, and [b]amii[/b] for designing the [i]Butterfly[/i] outfit. I had a lot of fun bringing your visions to life!

[h1]🌟 Steam Deck Verified[/h1]
I also made a bunch of improvements under the hood, which allowed [i]Artificial Fashionista[/i] to become [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/fb20d7e782ff9c2a883084555c22b7cbac7dd90f.png[/img]

[h1]🌟 Patch Notes[/h1]
Here's everything that's new and improved in [b]Version 3.2[/b]:
[list]
[*] New Item: Sparkle eyes!
[*] New Aspect Ratio settings!
[*] 3 New Hair Colors: Salmon, Teal, and Platinum Blonde!
[*] Improved the sharpness of images on smaller screens.
[*] Made the hair color palette smaller so it's visible on one screen.
[*] Compatibility for new DLC items.
[*] Search filters now also work on Sets and Backgrounds.
[*] Changed the layering of the Cutout Leotard & Monokini to always be in the back.
[*] Improved layering of various jacket & top combos.
[*] Moved wings further to the back.
[*] Replaced some backgrounds.
[*] Gamepad glyphs are scaled along with the text size setting.
[*] Fixed the display of hair in the "Worn" screen.
[*] Fixed filtering with "AND".
[*] Fixed display errors.[/list]

[h1]🌟 Bundle[/h1]
As always, you can also check out these bundles for an added discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45143/Artificial_Fashionista__Closet_Expansion/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49171/?snr=1_5_9_

[h1]🌟 What's next?[/h1]
Like I previously announced, the Extra DLC pack was the final one, and I'm extremely grateful for how much love you've shown this little game over the past year. I will dedicate myself fully to [i]Artificial Selection[/i] again soon, BUT...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1389870/Artificial_Selection/

...Before that happens, I have one last major improvement for [i]Artificial Fashionista[/i] in the works:

[b]Challenge Rewards.[/b] That's right! To give you an additional incentive to play challenge mode, I plan to add an exclusive reward item for beating each individual challenge. 

I'm not sure yet if all rewards of a collection should add up to one complete outfit, or if each challenge should give you a specific accessory matching its own theme, so I'm looking forward to hearing your opinions! Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments, or in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2924880/discussions/0/4337609007230891375/]Outfit Ideas[/url] discussion. I'd be happy to add that niche item you still think is missing!

Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: New Title Art & Contest Winner Announcement!
notes.content:
Hey, little critters!

Some of you might've already noticed the new look a few days ago, but now it's official: Artificial Fashionista received a new title art across all stores, and this is also reflected in the updated main menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/ca3127b9f4f2364f12bd97ba2ff23bbe7348bef2.png[/img]

Aside from that, the latest version comes with the following improvements:
[list]
[*] A new setting for larger UI text.
[*] Drop shadows for the look book wallpapers.
[*] Added the ability to advance text by scrolling down.
[*] Added a fade in to the dialogue text.
[/list]
I hope you enjoy!

[h2]Extra DLC Pack[/h2]
Next up, the store page for the [b]final DLC[/b] pack is now live! [b]Wishlist[/b] it and look through the screenshots to see some of the fun outfits coming your way next month:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3582580/Artificial_Fashionista__Extra_Collection/

And now, it's time for today's main event!

[h2]Contest Winner Announcement[/h2]
It was such a joy to watch your [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2924880/discussions/0/592891078960487262/]stunning entries[/url] come in over the course of last month, and some of them truly blew me away with their creative item combinations. [b]Thank you so much[/b] to everyone who entered, and for making this such a fun little event!

Since everyone decided to enter with 3 outfits, I also chose to consider all three looks for each participant's rating. The criteria I considered were:
[list]
[*] Unique theme - Did the entry present a unique idea?
[*] Creative item use - Does the entry combine and layer items in creative ways?
[*] Personal appeal - Does the outfit look good? (subjective opinion)[/list]
With those three aspects in mind, the results are as follows...

[h3]3rd Place[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/68723c5555b57e8ab09b37fee08df0cf7cef8800.jpg[/img]

On the same day as the contest was even announced, [b]amii[/b] jumped in with this very strong entry! 

The costume party and masquerade ball were both unique and creative ideas, and the third look was a very stylish and pleasing spin on the classic "Celebration" theme!

[b]Prize[/b]: Key for the Extra DLC!

[h3]2nd Place[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/26e51e8a4caada1a702b46bf52541d3eadb45c4c.jpg[/img]

Next up we have [b]rockerz3221[/b] covering three very different party types, each one executed perfectly. My personal favorite is the "rave" outfit, combining items from 9 different sets, and nonetheless creating a really cool and cohesive look! 

[b]Prize[/b]: Key for the Extra DLC!

[h3]1st Place[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/f28d2518e88ff4b57f9136f4d81f10753678e077.jpg[/img]

Wow, where do I even start? The garden party look is classy and gorgeous, "birthday clown" is such a fun idea, and the beautiful "wonderland tea party" successfully creates the illusion of a long-sleeved black dress which doesn't actually exist in-game!

This makes [b]Boonie[/b] our grand prize winner. Congratulations!

[b]Prize[/b]: Design an outfit for the Extra DLC & get a Key!

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

Thank you again for all your entries - even those who didn't win were stunning, and I hope you had fun!

[b]To all winners[/b]: To avoid having to publicly share your contact information, please message [b]contact@kigyodev.com[/b] and then reply to this announcement confirming that you sent an email (so I can verify it's you). I'll then send you a key and I'll coordinate with the first prize winner on how to put their requested look together!
[i](Make sure to do so until April 8th, or I will unfortunately have to pick a new winner.)[/i]

[h2]Commissions Open![/h2]
[url=https://ko-fi.com/c/b2f5933666][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/45215fad4063f4401d61b5957504cb9465a1eea0.png[/img][/url]

Last but definitely not least, if you are also interested in creating a custom look for Artificial Fashionista's final DLC, I've opened [url=https://ko-fi.com/c/b2f5933666]"Custom Outfit DLC" commissions[/url] for a limited time! Each commissioned outfit will be added to the extra DLC pack on top of the already planned ones, so this might be your last chance to get that one item you always wanted!

As always, thank you for your support, and I hope you look forward to the DLC coming out next month!

notes.title: Our First Fashion Contest!
notes.content:
Hey, little critters!

Time really flies, seeing as the [b]1 year anniversary[/b] of [i]Artificial Fashionista[/i] is already coming up! 
(If that sounds early to you, it's because it was published on Itch.io 2 months before coming to Steam!)

For this special occasion, I have exciting things planned, the first of which being:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/2f6d71a65b4f7e4f5d8f45ffe73ae90217642859.png[/img]

[h2]The FINAL DLC PACK[/h2]
Breaking free from seasonal constraints, this pack features the 5 outfits that were previously available for a limited time on my [url=https://ko-fi.com/kigyodev/shop/artificialfashionista]Ko-fi[/url], and 3 unrevealed outfits: A secret surprise, a community-voted look, and a very special outfit that can be designed by one of you!

...Wait, what do I mean by "designed by one of you"? 
I'm glad you asked, because that leads me to our very first:

[h2]Community Fashion Contest[/h2]
Just like in the game's finale, all of you are cordially invited to design your best Celebration look for this special occasion! Though what exact kind of celebration it is will be left up to you. Feel free to interpret the theme in creative ways, be it a game anniversary celebration, a cocktail party, an office Christmas party - just make sure to keep that "Fancy" stat high!

The winner gets to [b]suggest or design one outfit[/b] that will be in the final DLC pack, and both the winner and [b]two runner-ups[/b] will get [b]free DLC keys[/b]!

[b]> [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2924880/discussions/0/592891078960487262/]Participation & Rules[/url] <[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/6f4b1e9628d8b7d6704ecdea7cbf30a558d48a2a.png[/img]

[h2]Survey[/h2]
While we're on it, I'd like to get your opinion on [i]Artificial Fashionista[/i] (and fashion games in general) in this survey:

[b]> [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScvo_Q2c-9vRZ4VNvujMVze40kErvbBc1u9LOp8T6k13pVIMA/viewform?usp=dialog]Fill out Survey[/url] <[/b]

After this final DLC, [i]Artificial Fashionista[/i] likely won't be getting any new content anymore, but that doesn't mean the dress-up fun has to end! This project has taught me a lot, and I'm always looking for ways to make my next ones even better!

To thank you for your time, I will also be [b]giving away an additional free copy of the DLC[/b] among all the people filling out the survey!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
Oh right, I also updated the game today. It really just contains 2 small improvements:
[list]
[*] Added the option to automatically filter a specific challenge's tags! (Either by clicking on them directly, or in the filter menu.)
[*] Removed the "best score" aspect from challenge mode. Just sit back and enjoy making pretty looks!
[/list]

To check what else I'm up to, I also set up a [url=https://trello.com/b/PdCApzps/kigyodev-schedule]public Trello board[/url] where you can track my monthly progress. Upcoming release dates and other noteworthy events are also listed there!

Thank you so much for your support over the past (almost) year, and I look forward to seeing your creations!

notes.title: The Spring DLC is here! 🐝
notes.content:
Hey, little critters!

Spring has come early, and the final seasonal DLC pack is now out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3045950/Artificial_Fashionista__Spring_Collection/

I again tried to include as many of your wishes as possible, and I hope you enjoy creating all-new combos! The DLC has these 5 new styles:
[list]
[*]Lovecore
[*]Angel
[*]Bee
[*]Cherry Blossom
[*]Bunny[/list]
[h2]New Item Alert![/h2]
The new [b]Sprout[/b] head accessory is freely available to all players starting today!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/372213c8bcd11af942f0614d3b1ad22e9716f96a.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Item: Sprout!
[*] New Feature: If you own at least one DLC, you can now filter clothing by "Collection"!
[*] 3 New Hair Colors: Fuchsia, Eclipse, and Grass!
[*] Compatibility for new DLC items.
[*] Improved gamepad controls for the Save/Load screen.
[*] Removed the "Snapshot" button during story mode since it may accidentally expose your name during streams.
[*] Hair color no longer resets to blonde when switching to a registered look.[/list]
[h2]Bundle[/h2]
Last but not least, the DLCs are cheaper if you get them together!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45143/Artificial_Fashionista__Closet_Expansion/

Even wilder is the new [b]KigyoDev's Vault[/b] bundle, containing all my games and DLC!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/49171/KigyoDevs_Vault/

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
Thank you so much for your support over the course of the last few seasons! This may have been the final [i]seasonal [/i]DLC, but I have one more surprise in store for you. Although [i]Artificial Fashionista[/i] didn't reach as many people as I had hoped, this small but dedicated community makes all the hard work worth it. It always brightens my day seeing all the creative looks you post in the community!

I won't take away too much, but look forward to another [b]big announcement next month[/b]!

Thanks again, and see you in the next one!

notes.title: The Winter DLC is here!
notes.content:
Hey, little critters!

I'm happy to announce the winter DLC is now out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3045940/Artificial_Fashionista__Winter_Collection/

As your vote decided, the [b]5 included outfits[/b] are: Santa, Reindeer, New Year Kimono, Sugar Plum Fairy, and Snow Queen!

Thank you for your amazing suggestions and active participation in the poll! Since it was a really close call, I made the Reindeer look incorporate some of the "bundled up" elements. I tried my best to make sure there's something for everyone in this set!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Greatly improved image loading performance.
[*] 3 New Hair Colors: Ice, Eclipse, and Fir!
[*] Compatibility for new DLC items.
[*] Fixed the alignment of items in the Closet screen.
[/list]
I converted almost all of the assets to a much more lightweight image format, which should noticeably improve the game performance. (At least for me, it really started to struggle on pages with a ton of items.) Unfortunately, it's possible this will cause a few compatibility errors (even though I tried my best to get rid of them), so let me know when that happens, and I'll fix them ASAP!

Last but not least, for a limited time, anyone booting up the game will get the [b]"Low Twintail" hairstyle for free[/b]! Afterwards, it will remain an exclusive part of the winter DLC. I hope you enjoy, and I can't wait to see all your cute looks!

As always, the DLCs are cheaper together, so go make use of this discount if you haven't already!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45143/Artificial_Fashionista__Closet_Expansion/

Thank you for your support, and see you in the next one! 
[i](I may or may not already be brainstorming for the Spring DLC...)[/i]

notes.title: The Summer DLC is here!
notes.content:
Hey, little critters!

I'm happy to announce the summer DLC is now out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3045920/Artificial_Fashionista__Summer_Collection/

It contains [b]5 new outfits[/b], of which 3 have fancy new [b]sunglasses[/b]. This made me realize the necessity of a new "Glasses" category, which has now been added to the main game as well!

Aside from that, I've also added a few other enhancements, such as better visibility of the cursor when using a controller, performance improvements, and more!

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the "Glasses" category!
[*] Added tags to the challenge menu.
[*] Split the look book into pages and removed the spinning Foris heads for better performance.
[*] Made it easier to tell where your cursor is during dress-up mode.
[*] DLC clothing won't be usable on your first playthrough (to preserve the difficulty).
[*] Your installed DLCs are shown on the main menu.
[/list]

As always, if you have any further suggestions or ideas, don't hesitate to drop them!

Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: NEW: Challenge Mode!
notes.content:
Hey, little critters!

I just dropped another new feature: [b]Challenge mode[/b]!

You can access it from the main menu to replay the previous challenges and aim for a new [b]high score[/b].
On top of that, there are [b]9 new challenges[/b] for you to tackle, taking every attribute to the extreme!

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Feature: Challenge mode, with 9 new challenges!
[*] Clothes you've already collected are marked as such on NG+.
[*] The dress-up booth now plays the right music.
[*] Wearing a set no longer resets the background.
[*] Made sure the logo won't cover your creations in wallpaper mode.
[*] The scarf now covers all tops.
[*] Restructured the main menu.
[*] Fixed a crash when checking your worn clothes with a different hair color.
[*] Made hair previews prettier.
[*] Fixed a few transparency errors.
[/list]

Let me know if you have any additional challenge ideas - I'll gladly consider adding them!

[h2]DLC coming soon[/h2]

You might also notice a new entry in the DLC section of the closet:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/f80fcd999acd04a4c98c46cc92561b9e176f8443.png[/img]

This outfit, along with 4 other fresh summer looks, will be available at the beginning of July. I hope you're looking forward to it!

Thank you for your support!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/3j6wDw5afC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/cf4ac127af632c67119b3fc1fb0cc93df126ca94.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Hair Colors & Belts Update!
notes.content:
Hey, little critters!

Thanks to a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2924880/discussions/0/4337609007230891375/]great suggestion[/url] in our community, it's time for our first feature update: You can now change Foris' hair color!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/bac4a0a1d6dbef4ee685e2239036ef09e2890f80.png[/img]

I also reorganized the clothes a bit, and added the new "Belt" category:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970742/dc12605a7fafebb94d2d269d939b4a066aeaa2dc.png[/img]

There are 2 new belts to get you started, and it also means you can now combine the towel with pants or skirts (and not just dresses/swimsuits, like before)!

[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added hair color options!
[*] Added the "Belt" category with 2 new items!
[*] Reorganized the categories into "Clothes" (containing tops, bottoms, and bodies) and "Cover" (containing jackets and belts).
[*] Added the ability to switch between XBOX and PS4 controller icons, or turn them off completely.
[*] Removed Foris' toes from all slippers. (sorry)
[*] Added a "Reset" button directly to the "Worn" view.
[*] Hopefully fixed an achievement bug.
[/list]

I hope you continue to enjoy [i]Artificial Fashionista[/i], and thank you for your support!
